query: SELECT ms.name as set_name, ms.slug, mc.id, mc.cardNumber, mc.characterName, mc.cardType, mc.imageUrl FROM marvel_cards mc JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id WHERE mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%CBH-%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%placeholder%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%hulk-comic%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%generic%' ORDER BY ms.id, mc.cardNumber LIMIT 50;
